title: DevX Initiative: SDK + Quickstart Cohort OKR Tracker and Playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: Create an operational playbook and live OKR tracker for the Q1/Q2 DevX initiative that ties SDK + Quickstart cohort experiments to measurable adoption and retention goals.

Background: We have growing signups for the SDKs and quickstarts but conversion/retention signals are noisy. This initiative consolidates instrumentation, defines cohort experiments, and creates a repeatable cadence for product + growth + eng to run adoption sprints. The playbook will be used by Solutions Eng, Growth PMs, and SDK owners.

Goals (OKRs mapped):
- O1: Increase 14-day active rate for SDK trial projects from 18% to 30% by end of Q2. (KR1: instrument retention funnel; KR2: run 6 cohort experiments)
- O2: Reduce time-to-first-success (sample app running) from 45 min -> 15 min. (KR: standardize 3 quickstarts and measure TTF success)
- O3: Improve SDK issue-to-fix SLAs: 90% of critical adoption-blocking bugs resolved within 5 business days.

Scope: Playbook covers cohort segmentation, experiment recipes, measurement dashboard requirements, SE runbook for outreach, success criteria, and escalation paths. Excludes deep runtime changes (handled by ENG roadmaps) and broader docs platform migrations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Shared Confluence playbook with step-by-step cohort setup, 3 experiment templates, and an engagement cadence.
- A Grafana dashboard (or Looker SQL tile) with cohort retention, time-to-first-success, activation funnel, and per-quickstart telemetry.
- Two pilot cohorts executed with writeups and recommended next steps.
- Hand-off checklist and 1-hour training session scheduled for SE/growth.

Success signals: upward trend of 14-day retention in pilot cohorts, reduction of time-to-first-success in telemetry, and operationalized weekly review in the DevX standup.
comments: 2026-02-16 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff complete. Stakeholders: Solutions Eng (Marta Ruiz), Growth PM (Ravi Shah), SDK owners (June Wu). Agreed scope and success metrics. Action: instrument minimal event set (project.created, quickstart.started, quickstart.completed, sdk.install-error).
2026-02-24 - Liam O'Connor: Instrumentation PR opened for events schema. Draft telemetry dashboard query in dashboard-sandbox. See PR: github.com/redwood-inference/devx/PR/1123
2026-03-02 - Marta Ruiz: Ran first pilot cohort with 18 devs; observed drop at quickstart.setup step. Filed ENG ticket ENG-39122 for flaky container images. Added remediation task to playbook.
2026-03-04 - Ravi Shah: Experiment template v1 reviewed. Feedback: add automated email nudges at day 2 and day 7 that link to troubleshooting guide; assign SE touch at day 3 for high-value signups.
2026-03-07 - June Wu: Reviewed OKR mapping; propose adding KR around documentation clarity measured by time-on-doc and zero-help sessions. Planning a small copy rewrite for quickstart README.

2026-03-10 - Liam O'Connor: Pilot #2 completed (35 devs). Early signals: time-to-first-success median down to 22 minutes for cohort using interactive quickstart, retention up to 24% at day 7. Next: finalize playbook and schedule training week of 2026-03-22.
notes: Trade-off: aggressive instrumentation increases early signal clarity but raises event volume/cost—we will limit to 6 core events for pilot and iterate.
Decision log: prefer cohort-based outreach (small seeded groups) over mass emails for early experiments to collect qualitative feedback quickly.
Next steps: schedule SE training, finalize dashboard queries, merge instrumentation PR, and publish Confluence playbook v1.
Follow-ups: turn successful cohort recipes into templated Quickstart GitHub repos and add to the SDK onboarding matrix.
